scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito entered the storeroom first to look for toner, followed shortly by Mr Abiodun Castellanos fetching paper. They argued about a missed deadline, Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito shoved Mr Abiodun Castellanos, who fell against the grey cabinet, and Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito then left alone for the studio while Mr Abiodun Castellanos later got out to the corridor where Ms Clementine Alvarenga found him.

supporting_facts.text: CCTV and access logs place card C-017 and then card C-041 entering the storeroom about a minute apart, with the door then staying closed for an extended period.
A faint thud and raised voices were recorded while both were inside, and Ms Clementine Alvarenga also heard a thump from her desk.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos reported an argument, being shoved hard, and hitting his head on the edge of the grey cabinet.
Blood was found on the cabinet edge and on the storeroom floor, and the injuries are consistent with a fall against a hard edge.
Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito was recorded leaving the storeroom alone and walking west towards the studio, and Mr Abiodun Castellanos was later found bleeding against the corridor wall.

contradicted_points.text: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito denied that Mr Abiodun Castellanos was in the storeroom with him and denied touching him, which conflicts with this account and with the overlapping CCTV and access records.
The CCTV log states the storeroom door did not open again after Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito left, which does not by itself explain how Mr Abiodun Castellanos reached the corridor wall.
The medical note says the mechanism cannot be determined from the injuries alone, so a shove versus another fall mechanism is not medically settled.
